title: Grateful Dead Live at War Memorial Auditorium on 1983-04-15
lineage: Cassette Master (Namamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Audio Technica Mics -> Cassette Master (Sony D6/Maxell UDXL-II/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Outstanding audience recording of a spectacular April ’83 show, captured with crystal clarity and praised for the venue’s superb acoustics.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this tape as an exemplary audience capture that showcases a “great show” performed in a small, acoustically rich venue. The recording is described as clear, vivid, and fully representative of the concert’s energy, making it a must‑listen for fans of this era.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews consistently praise both the performance and the audio quality, indicating an excellent show with a top‑tier audience recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear capture with strong presence of crowd ambience; no reported hiss, dropouts, or muddiness – reviewers highlight what a good audience recording can achieve.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers focus on the overall beauty and energy of the concert rather than specific set details, noting the venue’s intimate vibe and “Phil Zone” bass response.

band_member_comments.Phil: Reviewer mentions a strong ‘Phil Zone’ thanks to the venue’s acoustics, indicating an especially resonant bass performance.
